about: Team radio lines. {name} is filled in at runtime: {pos} / {gap} numbers, spoken from the number clips. Each piece of fixed text between placeholders is its own recorded clip (scripts/radio/generate.py), so every language keeps its own word order.

radio_check.en: Radio check. Good luck out there.

lap_report.en: You are P{pos}. Car ahead is {gap} seconds up the road.

lap_leading.en: You are leading. Gap to second is {gap} seconds.

defend.en: Car behind is within a second. Defend.

attack.en: Car ahead is within a second. Go for it.

tyres_wearing.en: Tyres are starting to go. Look after them.

box_tyres.en: Box, box. Box this lap, the tyres are gone.
box_tyres.ko: 박스, 박스. 이번 랩에 들어와. 타이어가 다 됐어.

wing_damage.en: Front wing damage. Box this lap.
wing_damage.ko: 프런트 윙 손상. 이번 랩에 들어와.

puncture.en: Puncture! Bring it back to the pits.

floor_damage.en: Floor damage. We have lost some downforce.

vsc.en: Virtual safety car. Slow down, no overtaking.
vsc.ko: 가상 세이프티카. 속도 줄이고 추월 금지.

vsc_ending.en: Virtual safety car ending. Get ready.

safety_car.en: Safety car, safety car. No overtaking, close up to the car ahead.
safety_car.ko: 세이프티카, 세이프티카. 추월 금지, 앞차 뒤로 붙어.

sc_in.en: Safety car in this lap. Get ready for the restart.
sc_in.ko: 세이프티카 이번 랩에 들어간다. 재출발 준비해.

green.en: Green flag, green flag. Go, go, go!

brake_later.en: You can brake later into that corner.
brake_later.ko: 방금 코너는 브레이크를 더 늦게 밟아도 돼.

brake_earlier.en: Too late on the brakes there. Brake a bit earlier.
brake_earlier.ko: 브레이크가 늦었어. 조금 더 일찍 밟아.

win.en: Get in there! You win the race!
